Meet-AI setup guide

From install to your first report in about five minutes. Follow these steps once; after that, every meeting is tracked automatically.

You need

Chrome, Edge or Brave on a laptop or desktop computer.

Works with

Google Meet, and the Zoom web client (beta).

Who installs it

Only you. Participants do not need to install anything.

  1. 1

    Create your Meet-AI account

    • Open the Meet-AI dashboard and sign up with your email, or continue with Google.
    • This is where all your meetings and reports are saved.
  2. 2

    Download the extension

    • Download the Meet-AI extension zip from this website or from Settings → Browser Extension in your dashboard.
    • Unzip it into a folder you will keep, for example Documents/Meet-AI. Do not delete this folder later.
  3. 3

    Add it to Chrome

    • Open chrome://extensions in the address bar.
    • Turn on Developer mode (top-right corner).
    • Click Load unpacked and select the unzipped Meet-AI folder.
    • Pin the Meet-AI icon from the puzzle-piece menu so it is always visible.
  4. 4

    Connect the extension to your account

    • Click the Meet-AI icon, then Connect.
    • A dashboard page opens. Click Connect there to approve.
    • The code is valid for five minutes. The extension shows your email once it is connected.
  5. 5

    Schedule a meeting (optional, recommended)

    • In the dashboard, create a meeting and paste its Google Meet or Zoom link.
    • Pick a participant list and set the late cutoff time.
    • This turns on list comparison, late marking and absent email alerts for that meeting.
  6. 6

    Join and let it run

    • Open the meeting in Chrome and join the call. Tracking starts on its own.
    • A “MeetTrack live” badge appears in the bottom-right corner, and captions are switched on for you.
    • Keep the tab open for the whole meeting.
  7. 7

    Get your report

    • When you leave or the host ends the call, the report downloads automatically.
    • It is also uploaded to your dashboard, where you can download the PDF again any time.

Troubleshooting


The badge does not appear.

Make sure you have joined the call (not just the preview screen), the extension is enabled in chrome://extensions, and you refreshed the Meet tab after installing.

The extension says it is not connected.

Click Connect again and approve within five minutes. If you signed out of the dashboard, sign in first.

No participant list comparison in my report.

The meeting link in your dashboard must match the link you joined, for example meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij, and a list must be attached to the meeting.

The transcript is empty.

Check that captions (CC) are on in the meeting and that your organisation allows them.

The report did not download.

Chrome may have blocked multiple downloads. Allow downloads for meet.google.com, or download the PDF from your dashboard.

I updated the extension and nothing changed.

Open chrome://extensions, click the reload icon on Meet-AI, then refresh your Meet tab.
